bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 17.8K on Instagram, and your top offer is a $5,997 coaching program.
beats.text: MMU has three tiers: the Blueprint, the Mastery mentoring and 1-on-1 coaching with you and Tarique. The highest one is the one that needs a real sales process, not a checkout button.

beats.title: The first link on your Linktree sells your time by the hour.
beats.text: One hour with you is $247, two hours $347, booked straight on Calendly with no questions first. The $5,997 coaching program never comes up. A call funnel turns the same interest into applications for the coaching instead of one-off sessions.

beats.title: Your YouTube channel is gone. Your pages still say you share your progress there.
beats.text: The Mighty Stocks channel now shows a removal notice, and the Merciless Markets channel has one video. Trust now has to be built on Instagram and in your own funnel, not on YouTube.
beats.quote: “This channel was removed because it violated our Community Guidelines.”

beats.title: “Teachable and Calendly already work.” They stay.
beats.text: Teachable keeps delivering the courses and Calendly keeps the calendar. The funnel sits in front of both: a page that sells the coaching, an application before the calendar, six pre-call emails, and ads without profit screenshots, in line with what you already tell people.
beats.quote: “Remember Day Trading is hard and there is NO GUARANTEES of success”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You chase the move and get stuck
cards.body: The stock rips, you buy late, it halts or dumps, and the gain turns red. The idea was right. The execution wasn't.

cards.title: You learn alone
cards.body: Videos and chatrooms show the trades. Nobody reviews yours and tells you what you keep doing wrong.

cards.title: One bad day undoes a good week
cards.body: Without hard rules for size and stopping, a single choppy session takes back everything.

mechanism.title: The Hyper-Scalping process
mechanism.body: Hyper-scalping means many small, fast trades on volatile small caps, with strict risk on every one. It only works with discipline. In coaching you build it step by step with Marcelo: the strategy, the tape reading, the execution and a daily routine you can repeat.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.previewText: Your call with Marcelo is confirmed
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a few recent trades ready: screenshots, a trade tracker or your broker history all work. If you're brand new, just come ready to talk about your goals.

One note: payments only happen through the official Merciless Markets links, never in DMs.

Talk soon,
Marcelo

preCallEmails.subject: Why most small-cap traders give it all back
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most traders who blow up on small caps pick decent stocks. They lose it on execution: chasing, holding a halt, sizing up after a loss.

That's why coaching starts with your process, not a new setup: when you trade, how big, and when you stop for the day.

On the call we'll look at where your process breaks today.

Marcelo

preCallEmails.subject: "I already have the courses. Why coaching?"
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The MMU courses teach the strategy. That doesn't change.

What a course can't do is look at your trades one by one and tell you which mistake you keep repeating. That's what 1-on-1 coaching is for: a plan for you, trade revisions and direct Q&A.

If you can fix it on your own, you don't need it, and I'll tell you so on the call.

Marcelo

preCallEmails.subject: What the call is (and isn't)
preCallEmails.previewText: No trade calls, no promises, just a straight conversation
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

So you know what to expect:

- The call takes about 30 minutes.
- We'll talk about your experience, your goals and what's been holding you back.
- If coaching fits, I'll explain what's included and the investment.
- If it doesn't, I'll tell you and point you to the free resources.

What the call isn't: no stock picks, no trade calls, no promises of profits. Day trading involves substantial risk.

Marcelo
